t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Some gnomes are worth more points which increment as the rounds go by and are worth more, so to try and remember which points attribute to which gnome and try to select those going forward for maximum points

vb_textbox.text: Contrary to the original advice, I found that when a gnome starts giving 0 or low mushrooms it doesn't really recover quick enough, it's much easier to switch to another gnome given the choice. Starting off, it's best to try each gnome to gauge a scoring, I found that focusing on 4 gnomes, and remembering those was the best way, and then if none of the 4 come up, random selection helped. Switching gnomes in and out of the main 4 worked great for me.
